# Chepatapa Apps

> Independent studio building small, privacy-first mobile apps and developer tools. Built and maintained by one developer, Tsimafei Lemeshchanka, largely with an AI-assisted (Claude Code) workflow.

## Mobile apps

- [Flare](https://another1dd.github.io/flare/): Hot flash and night sweat tracker for menopause. Logs each episode against possible triggers (caffeine, alcohol, stress, spicy food, hot rooms) and shows which ones actually correlate with your episodes, instead of guessing. Free, no account, local-only storage. Live on the iOS App Store.
- [Kin Compass](https://another1dd.github.io/kincompass/): Daily routines and communication scripts for parents of preschoolers (ages 3-5) with ADHD. Ready-made routines, "what to say" scripts for tantrums/transitions/refusals, and win tracking. Free, no account, local-only storage. Live on the iOS App Store.
- [Bloomelle](https://another1dd.github.io/bloomelle/): Menstrual cycle-phase planning coach — forecasts the coming week and suggests which days may suit workouts, focus work, big decisions, or rest. Explicitly not a symptom tracker. Submitted for iOS App Store review; Android build in closed testing.
- [Naveli](https://another1dd.github.io/naveli/): Postpartum recovery yoga. Stage-based sequences (early recovery, around the 6-week check, beyond 6 weeks), routing by delivery type (vaginal or C-section), pelvic-floor safety cues in every sequence, and a diastasis recti self-check. No account, local-only storage of recovery details. Currently in development, no fixed release date yet.

- [Kin Compass printable routine charts](https://another1dd.github.io/kincompass/routine-charts/): Four free one-page visual routine charts for preschoolers (morning, after-daycare, dinner, bedtime) as A4 and US Letter PDFs. No signup.
- [Kin Compass scripts](https://another1dd.github.io/kincompass/scripts/): Six practical scripts for hard moments with a preschooler (refusing to get dressed, leaving the park, tantrum in the store, talking after a tantrum, not listening, getting out of bed), each with exact wording, reasoning and CDC sources. Practical communication techniques, not medical advice.

- [Flare printable hot flash diary](https://another1dd.github.io/flare/trigger-diary/): Free two-page printable diary (A4 and US Letter PDF) for logging hot flashes, intensity, duration and 11 common triggers, with a tally sheet to see which triggers show up most. No signup.

## Developer tools (SaaS)

- [Perchly](https://perchly.dev): Private Swift Package Manager registry for teams, built on the real SE-0292 package registry protocol (not a proxy or git wrapper). Free tier plus paid Starter/Team plans.
- [Publy](https://publy.dev): Private Dart and Flutter package registry for teams — the pub.dev alternative that stays private. Free tier plus paid plans.
